Gestion des Droits d’Infrastructure

A process and toolset for discovering, controlling, and auditing permissions and access rights across cloud and hybrid infrastructure to minimize excessive privileges and enforce least privilege.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Gestion des Droits d’Infrastructure?

In this glossary, Gestion des Droits d’Infrastructure refers to: A process and toolset for discovering, controlling, and auditing permissions and access rights across cloud and hybrid infrastructure to minimize excessive privileges and enforce least privilege.

How is Gestion des Droits d’Infrastructure used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Effectuez un audit de gestion des droits d’infrastructure pour identifier les comptes cloud sur-privilégiés et supprimer les droits d’accès inutilisés."

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

A process and toolset for discovering, controlling, and auditing permissions and access rights across cloud and hybrid infrastructure to minimize excessive privileges and enforce least privilege.

Operational example

Run an infrastructure entitlement management audit to identify over-privileged cloud accounts and remove unused access permissions.

Localized term

Gestion des Droits d’Infrastructure

Localized example

Effectuez un audit de gestion des droits d’infrastructure pour identifier les comptes cloud sur-privilégiés et supprimer les droits d’accès inutilisés.
